title: GIRDER NEW 2025 DASH PRO
notes: Exact DASH PRO page lists ¥30,800; Toray T800+T1000 all-round frame and fork, EPS molding, hidden routing, BSA BB (68/73 mm stated), 12 mm thru-axles, UDH; Adler Augen integrated bar; 3D-printed carbon-rail saddle; Dura-Ace R9270 Di2 2×12, FC-R9200 52-36T 170 mm, CS-R9200 11-34T, CN-M9100, R9270 hydraulic discs; Adler Augen Golden Eagle 40 mm carbon wheels; Maxxis 28C; weight 7.38 kg (basis not stated). Official chart (shared by the DASH and BISON pages), stack/reach mm for listed sizes: 440 500/366, 490 514/375, 520 527/380, 540 545/384; seat angle 75.5–74°, head angle 70.5–73°, chainstay 410 mm, wheelbase 970–980 mm. The chart also lists 560 and 580 rows that the page does not offer and leaves BB drop blank. No clearance, frame weight or stiffness data. Read over HTTP, matching the site’s published links.
